notes.title: Exsys Update: One Step Closer to the Final Version!
notes.content:
Video Game Copy Writer
Custom Gem
Header: Exsys Update: One Step Closer to the Final Version!

Description:

I'm back with another Exsys update, and this time it's all about refinement! I've been hard at work polishing the game, squashing bugs, and incorporating your feedback to bring you closer to the final vision for Exsys.

This update includes:

 Gameplay tweaks and balance adjustments for a smoother and more satisfying experience.
 Bug fixes and performance improvements to ensure a stable and enjoyable journey.
 Further polish and refinement to bring the world of Exsys to life.


Thank you for your continued support! I can't wait for you to experience these latest improvements.

notes.title: Exsys Update: UI Refinements and Achievement Integration
notes.content:
We've implemented some quality-of-life improvements in this Exsys update, focusing on UI enhancements and Steam achievement integration.

Changes:


 Character Screen UI Refinement: The character screen UI has been updated for better readability and clarity.
 Steam Achievement Support: Unlock achievements as you progress through the game and showcase your mastery of Exsys.
 Fixed an issue where the elevator down from the residential area would cause a black screen.

This update aims to provide a more polished and rewarding experience for Exsys players.

notes.title: Exsys Update: Squashed Bugs & Slicker Moves!
notes.content:
Fixed
[olist]
 Resolved an issue where invalid ground geometry could cause the player to fall through the world.
 Fixed collision issues in certain stages that caused players to become stuck after jumping near boundaries.
 Prevented the dash skill from allowing players to pass through stage boundaries.
 Corrected a bug where fire bombs in the "Open the Gate" stage would disappear prematurely if they hit the player before hitting the ground.
 Ensured weapons are dropped correctly when the player is hit by projectile attacks.
 Added missing active skill command prompts.
[/olist]

Changed

 Increased overall player movement speed.
 Added missing sound effects to enhance the gameplay experience.
 Updated tutorial UI and added missing localized text.
 Improved the display of active skill command buttons for better readability.
 Updated the button icon for mashing actions.
 Reduced input latency for a more responsive control experience.
 Adjusted difficulty in early game stages for a smoother learning curve.

notes.title: Exsys: 2024 Update Launch
notes.content:
Exsys just got bigger, bolder, and more beautiful. We've rebuilt the world, expanded the story, and polished the gameplay to deliver the ultimate cyberpunk beat 'em up experience.


Key Features of this Massive Update:
[olist]
3D World Map Exploration: Say goodbye to static maps! Take direct control of your character in the new world map, encountering enemies to reach your next challenge. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35802079/4d260d47b97b7e0677c79d292f782b4b08cbc65a.png
The City of Trash Awaits: Embark on the second half of the epic Exsys story and explore a sprawling metropolis built on scrap. 
More Skills, More Power: Unleash devastating new active skills to decimate your foes and customize your fighting style.
Expanded Arsenal: Discover a treasure trove of new items, each with unique abilities to enhance your combat prowess.
Bug Fixes Galore: We've squashed countless bugs, ensuring a smoother, more immersive experience.
Now in More Languages: Play Exsys in your preferred language with added support for Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, French, German, and Spanish.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35802079/f345bac2893a9013f2fccb8b284afe0b51fdedd4.png
This is the Exsys you've been waiting for. Download the update now and embark on a journey of self-discovery, action, and adventure!

notes.title: Patch Sept-26-2023
notes.content:
This is a quick patch to fix numerous issues.


 Fixed colliders in certain areas that make the player fall off stages.
 Fixed items randomly become inactive and unable to be picked up when dropped.
 Fixed Fight camera is not released in the "Escape from the Cave" mission. 
 Fixed Boss in the "Open The Gate" mission goes off the game stage.
 Fixed the menu UI becomes not responsive when the player goes to the Pause screen while in tutorial active.
 Fixed resources are not consumed after fixing the bridge.


I hope this patch will help improve your experience with the game.  
And thank you all for reporting bugs and giving feedback. I will keep working on it to make the game better.

notes.title: Exsys Receives Major Update and 50% Discount for Tokyo Game Show Week!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35802079/1b736eb968ffc0aa96fce06ea0eabe62f75c0d06.png

I'm excited to announce that Exsys, my side-scrolling beat 'em up adventure game, is receiving a massive update just in time for Tokyo Game Show Week! This update includes a variety of new features and improvements, including:

 Focus more on storytelling: I have added a dialogue system and redesigned all of the game stages to help tell the game story in a more engaging way.
Improved Graphics: I have improved the game's graphics to make the world of Exsys even more immersive and exciting to support the story more.
New enemies and new boss: I have added more zombie enemy types and new boss characters to challenge players.
Improve and more aggressive AI behavior: I have improved the AI behavior to make the AI challenging and keep the gameplay exciting.
New resource system: Players can now gather resources around the game stage and use them to solve puzzles and for another future system.
New item types: I have added a couple of new item types to give players more options in combat and exploration.
Thai and Japanese localization support: Exsys will now be available in Thai and Japanese, in addition to English.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35802079/1636a59a4fb2117bd3ca1fcbf7f0930be98e3353.jpg

 Celebrating the Tokyo Game Show 
To celebrate the release of this update and the Tokyo Game Show, I'm also offering a 50% discount on Exsys on Steam! This sale will run from 21 - 26 September 2023.

I will also showcase the latest and greatest version of Exsys at the Tokyo Game Show! Be sure to stop by my booth to try out the new features and chat.

I hope you enjoy the new Exsys update and Tokyo Game Show Week.

notes.title: The Completely Rework of Exsys
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sxXUqXFEVVA;full][/previewyoutube]

Summary
After being so disappointing to all of you, the game has been reworked in every aspect. And focus solely on making it something that all of you can enjoy.

Exsys has become a combination of Action RPG, loot-based, and Beat 'em Up comes together to deliver something unique to the player. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35802079/ded23a0864a1a20f419d0ef14219ce09aa04f4cf.png
A bit of the story

Earlier
After our initial release, the game disappointed all of our early adopters and my former development team. The studio ran out of money months after the initial release, and we had no choice but to close down the studio. It was a very depressing time for all of us.

But I still want to make the game better and finish it. I spent all this time redesigning the game, testing many ideas, and learning all skills, mostly art skills and music, needed to make the game. 

Learning all of these skills to make the game under a limited amount of time and money was very stressful and fun at the same time. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35802079/7a86836c6473636abdc283bf178a2f349bda70e1.png


Now
Having managed to make it this far and see this new version of the game taking shape is rewarding. I also want to share this with all our early adopters who brought the game early and apologize for disappointing you. I hope you will enjoy this version of the game. 

I am eager to hear yours on this version if you have any. Suppose you found this version of the game still needs to be more enjoyable. Please feel free to let me know. A complaint is better than a siren. 

I would like to take this opportunity to apologize for disappointing all of our early adopters and my former development team. 


You can still play the legacy version
I have moved the legacy version of the Legacy Branch in case you want to see what has changed. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35802079/44c01ddab700c2225ba21a25570232c58b0b99dc.png

notes.title: Out now on Steam Early Access
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35802079/df1a9a81a7201e428036de4ee73561d15b2e7705.jpg

Exsys Is now available on Early Access. The game is only 15% done. But we want you to experience and involve in the development.  So we can make sure that we make the game to something you enjoy playing, and we enjoy making.

If you are an early adopter. Get it now! As the price will go up when the game is more polish and complete.


About the Game
What if you awake in a place that you are just something that nobody wants and wants to get rid of you? The only thing is to survive and get out of that place.

Play as a piece of garbage awake in the middle of a scrapyard, controlled by The System. No memory, no purpose, and feel lost wandering around try to survive and find a safe place.

Experience this  Metroidvania, rouge-like, beat em' up game. Explore the immersive world of The System. The very organized city and deluded form of order and security where everybody assigned the role and will be eliminated if they do not do what they told to do. You have to escape by finding exits that are scattered around the city.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35802079/e7f4015881dad880a7516e8722126982fb28a97f.png
